EB-08 is in and verified. Try it at **http://maker:4001/?demo=big** (a larger sample so paging shows). Click **Preferences** (top-right):

1. **Default sort order** — change it (e.g. Title A–Z). The list and the Sort control both adopt it as the starting order; you can still change the Sort control any time during a session.
2. **How many to show at once** — set it to 10. The list shows 10 with a **"Show N more"** button that loads the next batch. Importantly, **search and "Select all" still cover everything** — try searching `#news` (say 6 matches) and **Select all**: it selects all 6, not just what's on the page.
3. **Text size** — Small / Normal / Large adjusts the comfortable reading size for the whole app.

A few things to confirm:

- **Default sort as a preference**, with the per-session Sort control still available — right split?
- **"Show more" (load more)** rather than numbered pages for the display limit — does that feel calmer, or would you prefer page numbers? (Either way, searching and bulk **Select all** always act on the full matching set, never just the visible page.)
- **Three text sizes** (Small/Normal/Large) — enough, or do you want finer control?
- One honest note: in this preview your preferences last for the session; the finished app would **remember them** for you.

If this fits, that completes your whole follow-up list (editing, open/tag-filter, sorting, bulk actions, saved searches, page copies, import/export, and preferences). I'll record EB-08, and then — only with your go-ahead — ask again whether to start building the real application.
